rule_metadata.title: CMSTP App Paths Registry Key Modification

rules.rule_text:
title: CMSTP App Paths Registry Key Modification
id: b6d235fc-1d38-4b12-adbe-325f06728f37
status: stable
description: 'Detects modifications to the CMSTP App Paths registry key. This may
  indicate abuse of

  Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer (CMSTP) for arbitrary code execution
  or UAC bypass.

  '
references:
- https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Binaries/Cmstp/
- https://web.archive.org/web/20190720093911/http://www.endurant.io/cmstp/detecting-cmstp-enabled-code-execution-and-uac-bypass-with-sysmon/
- https://web.archive.org/web/20190722224110/https://oddvar.moe/2017/08/15/research-on-cmstp-exe/
author: Nik Seetharaman
date: 2018-07-16
modified: 2026-08-27
tags:
- attack.execution
- attack.stealth
- attack.t1218.003
- attack.g0069
- car.2019-04-001
logsource:
  category: registry_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetObject|contains: SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\cmmgr32.exe\
  filter_main_cmcfg32:
    TargetObject|endswith: SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\cmmgr32.exe\CmstpExtensionDll
    Details:
    - C:\Windows\System32\cmcfg32.dll
    - C:\Windows\SysWOW64\cmcfg32.dll
  filter_main_empty:
    Details: (Empty)
  condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate CMSTP use (unlikely in modern enterprise environments)
level: high
